finale_hardware: MacBook Air (Mac17,3), Apple M5, 10-core CPU, 8-core integrated GPU, 16 GB memory, macOS 26.6.2 arm64
method: Human-visible accessibility-tree and rendered-frame inspection of the exact packaged application, cross-checked against exact-head machine reports. No check was promoted from feature presence alone.

geo_tiff_metric_dsm.notes: Packaged offline DA3 reconstruction, calibration and persisted metric DSM completed; the UI explicitly reported a metric, evidence-calibrated DSM in metres.

nongeo_png_rdsm.notes: Exact packaged app reopened a PNG project as dimensionless rDSM; metric structure and validation tools remained unavailable.

nongeo_jpg_rdsm.notes: Exact packaged app reopened a JPG project as dimensionless rDSM without inventing metric elevation.

optical_source_view.notes: Optical tab rendered the registered RGB source and explicitly separated it from elevation semantics.

dsm_view.notes: DSM tab rendered the persisted calibrated surface, units, legend, cursor elevation and slope.

texture_projection_3d.notes: Source RGB texture was projected on non-empty 3D terrain and frame-validated during sustained navigation.

dsm_overlay_3d.notes: Metric DSM analytical overlay reached a frame-validated renderer state.

slope_overlay_3d.notes: Slope overlay rendered with a degree legend and frame validation while terrain geometry remained unchanged.

hillshade_3d.notes: Hillshade overlay loaded and frame-validated in the packaged renderer.

contours_3d.notes: Contour overlay loaded and frame-validated in the packaged renderer.

orbit_navigation.notes: Orbit drag changed the live camera while the scene maintained measured frame rate.

fly_navigation.notes: Fly mode and forward motion were exercised on the live terrain.

first_person_navigation.notes: First-person mode and forward movement were exercised on the live terrain.

top_down_navigation.notes: Top-down camera, pan semantics and registered terrain selection were observed.

deterministic_flythrough.notes: The deterministic display-only flythrough ran without changing project data.

auto_and_manual_lod.notes: Automatic LOD and manual LOD 2 were exercised; the UI reported LOD 2 manual and 8,192 nominal faces.

vertical_exaggeration.notes: Display-only 2x vertical exaggeration was selected and clearly distinguished from source elevations.

probe_3d.notes: A registered 3D surface click updated synchronized prediction, slope, reference and residual values.

measure_3d.notes: Two registered 3D surface endpoints produced pixel distance and signed metric elevation difference.

profile_3d.notes: A 160-sample 3D transect rendered prediction/reference profile and accumulated gain/loss.

structure_height_urban.notes: The exact packaged app measured an explicit four-vertex urban footprint on EPSG:32633 imagery with trusted 0.050 m GSD, physical 1.50-8.00 m ground support, 66.7% ground inliers and four-sector coverage. The UI surfaced a dispersion warning rather than concealing it.

reference_validation_independent.notes: Reference SHA differs from calibration evidence SHA; validation used 1,037,665 aligned pixels.

reference_view.notes: Reference view was visibly marked evaluation-only and displayed the aligned reference surface.

residual_view.notes: Residual view and point residuals rendered from the independent aligned reference.

projection_accuracy_visual.notes: Optical, DSM, reference and residual layers remained registered under synchronized point inspection; validation reports exact-grid alignment.

export_bundle.notes: Packaged workflow created and integrity-checked an 18.38 MiB hash-audited ZIP containing mesh and validation artifacts while excluding source imagery by default.

relaunch_reopen.notes: The exact app bundle relaunched and reopened the persisted RT5 project plus separate PNG, JPG and projected urban projects through the native project picker.

limitations: The RT5 fixture is metric but lacks trustworthy physical GSD, so structural height was correctly evidenced on a separate projected 5 cm GSD urban project instead.
The selected urban footprint produced a moderate-quality 2.220 m estimate and an explicit within-footprint dispersion warning; the warning is preserved as evidence of truthful UX, not suppressed.
Confidence UI remained disabled because the production DA3 path did not emit model-native confidence; no confidence artifact or probability semantics were fabricated.
